result.detail: Assertions use the immediate subset that the open Yosys front end reads. There are no sequences, no |-> and no named properties, so the antecedent derivation in formal.cover should not refuse them. The three checker instances share the top-level inputs. Each instance is still proved over all input sequences, because the inputs are free. No file is named deep_counter.v. The approved RTL is referenced by its name and placed beside these files by the platform. If induction ends UNKNOWN, read the induction trace before adding any assumption; any added helper must be an assertion. Proving every LIMIT from 1 to 127 would need either more instances or an anyconst-style abstraction of the parameter, which the RTL's parameter-only LIMIT does not allow. That scope question can go to verification.formal.proof.tech_lead if full DC-PARAM coverage is required. The independent-review evidence requirement must be met by a different seat.
